camel_example: aliyun live CreateLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveMessageGroup创建互动消息群组
kebab_example: aliyun live create-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group that you want to create. The group ID must be unique within your business. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的群组ID，业务应保证群组ID唯一，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the group. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 群组名，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The additional information about the group. The value can be up to 32 KB in length
parameters.help_zh: 群组扩展信息，长度不超过32KB
parameters.name: group_info

parameters.help_en: The ID of the group creator. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 群组创建者ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2593195.html operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2593195.html中的数据中心一致, 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AlreadyDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the group is deleted. If the group existed and is deleted, the group ID is unavailable. We recommend that you create a new group
AlreadyDelete.description_zh: 是否已删除。如果已存在，且被删除了，那么群组ID是处于不可用状态，建议重新创建

AlreadyExists.description_en: Indicates whether the group already exists

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the group created
